lyricsEditor.overview: Use this tool to edit the lyrics table on a wikipage. It is primarily aimed for Japanese/Chinese/Korean song pages.

guide.p1: Copy and paste the contents of the page's source code into the box below.
guide.p2: Click the "Extract Lyrics Table" button to extract the table into the columns below.
guide.p3: Edit the lyrics as needed. Click the "Generate" button to turn the table back into wikitext.
guide.wikiSourceHeader: To get the source code of the wiki page, you can either:
guide.s1: Open the wiki page on Wiki Editor.
guide.s2: Append "?action=raw" to the URL of the wiki page, e.g.
guide.s2AltText: View the page's source code on the Vocaloid Lyrics Wiki
